title: Distributed Task Scheduler
description: A high-throughput, fault-tolerant distributed task scheduler built with Rust and gRPC.
content:
### Key Features

- **High Throughput:** Processes 10k tasks/sec.
- **Fault Tolerant:** Raft consensus for high availability.
- **Language Agnostic:** Exposes gRPC endpoints.

### Tech Stack

- Rust (Tokio, Tonic)
- PostgreSQL
- Redis

title: AI Copilot for IDEs
description: An AI-powered pair programming tool leveraging LLMs for real-time code suggestions.
content:
### Overview

Built a highly responsive copilot extension for VS Code that streams LLM suggestions directly into your editor.

### Key Features

- **Context Aware:** Understands your entire workspace.
- **Fast Inference:** Streamed responses via WebSockets.
- **Secure:** Local processing mode available.

### Tech Stack

- TypeScript / Node.js
- Python (FastAPI)
- HuggingFace Transformers

title: DeFi Yield Aggregator
description: A Web3 smart contract protocol to automatically compound yields across multiple chains.
content:
### The Problem

Yield farming across multiple chains requires manually bridging, swapping, and staking tokens which costs high gas fees.

### The Solution

This protocol automatically routes funds to the highest-yielding pools across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon.

### Tech Stack

- Solidity (Smart Contracts)
- Next.js / React (Frontend)
- Ethers.js / Wagmi

title: Cloud Infrastructure Provisioner
description: Automated infrastructure-as-code CLI tool for multi-cloud deployments.
content:
### Why I Built This

Managing Terraform states for multi-region architectures was becoming a nightmare. This CLI abstracts the complexity of Terraform into simple YAML configuration files.

### Key Features

- **Multi-Cloud:** Supports AWS, GCP, and Azure out of the box.
- **State Management:** Encrypted remote state locks.
- **Rollbacks:** Instant rollback to previous infrastructure states.

### Tech Stack

- Go (Golang)
- Cobra CLI
- Terraform SDK
